title: Three Friends on Farm, 1930s Sepia Snapshot, USA
back_text_transcription: 457 L. Lillie Vanhooser Opal Flager Ed Hazelwood
description: A vintage 1930s sepia snapshot capturing three individuals—identified on the reverse as Lillie Vanhooser, Opal Flager, and Ed Hazelwood—standing outside a rural home next to a cornfield. The central woman wears a dark polka-dot dress with a wide ruffled collar, while the men wear classic 1930s casual trousers and workwear shirts, one holding a straw hat and the other wearing a flat cap. This image captures rural American community life during the Great Depression era.
